visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older man with grey hair and glasses, wearing a brown quilted vest over a light-colored long-sleeved shirt, stands by a light wood door that is slightly ajar. An orange and white tabby cat sits patiently on the wood floor nearby. A hand enters the frame from the bottom left making a shocked gesture. (2) The scene shifts to the floor where a white plastic top-entry cat litter box sits. The man leans over it, hands on his waist, looking confused at the object. The lighting is bright and even across the room. An air purifier and a white desk chair are visible in the background. (3) The man picks up the white lid with small holes on one side and a large square opening on the other. He laughs, realizing it was upside down. He flips the lid and snaps it correctly onto the base, his hands moving with deliberate action to secure it. (4) The orange cat approaches the now-assembled litter box. It stretches its body and places its front paws on the edge of the box to peer inside. The setting remains the same indoor domestic space with soft shadows and warm, natural tones. (5) The cat jumps onto the lid and cautiously enters the box through the square opening. The camera zooms in as the cat's head disappears into the box. The lighting highlights the texture of the cat's orange fur as it moves into the opening. (6) A close-up shows the cat's face as it pops its head out of the opening. It has several small white granules of cat litter stuck to its nose and upper lip. The cat looks directly toward the camera with wide, curious eyes and a blank expression.
